derivation product

  • CURIE: gmeow:derivationProduct
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/derivationProduct
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/creative-works
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The product creative work that was derived from the source. Functional per relator: one product per CreativeDerivation.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:CreativeDerivation -> gmeow:CreativeWork; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:derivationProduct from gmeow:CreativeDerivation to gmeow:CreativeWork when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:CreativeDerivation, gmeow:CreativeWork

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use inside a gmeow:CreativeDerivation to name the single product work that resulted from the derivation, at the honest tier (a new Expression for a cover, a new Recording for a remix).

Avoid when

  • Avoid asserting it outside a CreativeDerivation relator and avoid more than one product — it is functional.

How to use

  • Point the CreativeDerivation at one product gmeow:CreativeWork; pair with gmeow:derivationSource and gmeow:derivationType.

Examples

  • ex:d1 gmeow:derivationProduct ex:remix.
